messages:
lena: Quick heads-up: after toggling 'normalize_weights' on the pctl view for /v1/chat, p99 increased while p95 dropped. Feels like normalization semantics changed.
dave: Can you paste the merge query? Are we doing per-shard normalization?
lena: Backend merge path uses per-shard normalize by default right now. Query snippet: `merge_quantiles(0.5,0.95,0.99)(tdigest)` over rollup_shards with normalize=true.
priya: Per-shard normalize can bias tails if shard weights differ. A heavy-weighted outlier on a small shard inflates tail. Global normalize (scale shards by total weight) is better for global percentiles.
dave: Agree. Implementation note: we already store shard weight_sum on ingestion. We can fetch sums at merge time and scale densities. Perf cost should be small.
lena: UI asks for clarity. Can we add an explicit API param `percentile_semantics=global_normalized|local_normalized|unweighted` and default to global_normalized?
priya: Fine with that. I'll add tests: (1) heavy slow sample on tiny shard, (2) balanced weights.
telemetry-bot: rollup-merger v1.9.2 promoted earlier today.
dave: I'll open PR for rollup-merger to switch default to global_normalized and add the API param. JIRA PLAT-6002 created.
lena: Also request a small dashboard footer: show sample_count and weight_sum on tile so SREs can eyeball skew.
dave: Will add to API response. Small backfill needed for last 24h on top endpoints to avoid discontinuity. Plan: staged rollout, backfill top-20 endpoints for 6h, monitor.
priya: Deploying branch to staging now. deploy-bot: feature branch deployed to staging at 2024-06-05T03:40:05Z :white_check_mark:.
lena: Thanks. Please coordinate backfill window and add migration notes to console docs. Closing unless regressions. :thumbsup:
